patch_description: This replaces smooth soft-min/soft-max continuation with an exact-objective active-contact search. The construction begins from several antiprismatic and polyhedral seeds, then repeatedly identifies the currently shortest and longest distance classes. A rank-weighted force field repels short contacts and contracts long contacts, while every candidate step is accepted only when the evaluator-equivalent squared ratio improves. Multiple deterministic step sizes and occasional tangent perturbations provide a trust-region style search without relying on surrogate-score rollbacks.
